audience.statement: People who water compact indoor plants and want control near desks or shelves.

motivator.statement: Keep the plant-care ritual quick without moving the plant away from the desk.
motivator.testMethod: Test this use case against a bathroom use case.

painPoint.statement: A wide spray can reach a nearby work surface.
painPoint.testMethod: Do not publish as fact until validated; use only as a creative hypothesis.

useCase.statement: One trigger press aimed at a desktop fern.
useCase.testMethod: Observe comprehension in a five-second hook test.

trend.statement: Macro action followed by an immediate wide reveal is a pacing hypothesis for this asset.
trend.testMethod: Compare retention against a continuous wide shot.

hook.promise: See the targeted mist and the dry surrounding desk in one sequence.

taste.direction: Tactile eight-second desktop demonstration with one motivated camera move and a calm proof reveal.
taste.lighting: Consistent soft daylight from camera left; mist remains legible without artificial sparkle.
taste.photography: Natural commercial realism with restrained macro detail and smooth optical focus transitions.

continuityRules: Use the same bottle, trigger, label alignment, hand, fern, pot, and walnut desk across all shots.
Keep daylight direction, exposure, white balance, and desk wetness state continuous.
The carton enters only in shot_endcard and keeps its exact locked artwork.
